_comment: ACT 1 — the far side of the faction door. Two jobs, one each, both weekly.
`repeatable: true` is the whole of what makes these weekly: a repeatable
writes a w:<id> mark instead of a q:<id> one, and net/accounts.resetIfNewWeek
drops every w: on Monday along with the xp and the cursors. So it is done
for the week and comes round with the week. A story quest writes q:<id> and
`level: 2` is a RUNG, not a minimum: this is rung-2 work and it is offered
while you are level 2 and at no other time. It shares the rung with
act0-review, which is the door that opens it -- the review pays 400 xp and a
player who has just crossed into level 2 stays there, so the room is not
locked behind the door that opens it. See game/questmodel.ts's header.
`needFlags: [act1:open]` is what act0-review unlocks, and `faction` is the
side gate. Both are checked on the server against its own copy of this file.

quests.blurb: Sharnie has identified four real estate agents conducting business on land they do not own. Marita would like a word had.

steps.label: have a word with four agents

quests.title: Sixty Dollars, Unspecified
quests.blurb: Mick would like sixty dollars to exist that did not exist this morning. He has been careful not to say how.
